summary: Clary was a female Nomai who worked alongside Poke and Root in the Black Hole Forge on Brittle Hollow. She was Poke's sister and Yarrow's romantic partner, and co-discovered warp travel's negative time interval. She died on the Interloper, waiting in the shuttle while Poke and Pye descended.

behavior: Clary enjoys precision but said her precision did not match Poke's.
Clary mediated between Poke and Cassava during their frequent arguments.
location: Clary worked in the Black Hole Forge on Brittle Hollow with Poke and Root.
Clary's corpse can be found inside the shuttle on the Interloper.
lore: Clary was the sister of Poke.
Clary was the romantic partner of Yarrow.
Clary recreated warp travel with Poke and Root after building a warp platform on White Hole Station.
Clary made the first successful warp from White Hole Station to Brittle Hollow.
Clary helped Poke verify the negative time interval by testing the equipment repeatedly with the same result.
Clary posited that Poke could recreate Annona's advanced warp core because Poke had been Annona's apprentice.
Clary started crafting Ash Twin Tower warp cores with Poke and Root.
Yarrow first asked to meet Clary on White Hole Station to learn about the design; it was the start of their romantic relationship.
Poke teased Yarrow in writing for using a scroll wall to flirt with Clary and told him to just go meet her.
Poke described Clary's romantic density as rivaling a neutron star's.
Clary explained to Root that the black-hole cores should go to the warp towers on Ash Twin.
Clary clarified for Yarrow that the Hourglass Twins function as a single astral body with a shared alignment point because they are so close together.
Clary worried whether a warp tower's base shifting would break its alignment; Poke assured her alignment only needs to be within five degrees.
Clary told Yarrow the Advanced Warp Core was ready to install, overruling Poke's perfectionist objections.
Clary stayed behind in the shuttle on the Interloper to keep it warm and prevent it from freezing.
Poke and Pye descended into the Interloper's ice fissure to investigate strange energy readings.
Clary lost contact with Poke and Pye after they descended below the Interloper's surface.
Clary considered leaving the shuttle to look for Poke and Pye but tried to follow protocol.
Clary died in the shuttle when the Interloper's exotic-matter casing ruptured.
